About.title: About the App

appSection.p1: This reading app features a modern, intuitive interface designed to provide an exceptional reading experience. With support for multiple languages and a seamless dark/light mode, it adapts to your preferences effortlessly.
appSection.p2: Built with cutting-edge technologies including Next.js 14, React 19, and TypeScript, this application delivers fast performance and robust functionality. The UI is crafted using TailwindCSS and ShadCN components for a polished, professional look.
appSection.p3: Our internationalization system supports multiple languages, starting with English and Portuguese, with plans to expand to more languages. The app automatically detects your system preferences and language settings for a personalized experience.

About.developerBio: Full-Stack Developer specializing in modern web technologies, with a focus on creating performant, accessible, and user-friendly applications. Passionate about clean code and best practices.
